common.app_tagline: Complete the Qur'an in seven days with a simple daily reminder and progress tracker.

onboarding.step1_tagline: Complete the Qur'an in seven days with a simple daily reminder and progress tracker.
onboarding.hadith_quote: اقرأ القرآن في سبع ولا تزد على ذلك
onboarding.step2_title: When would you like to begin?
onboarding.step2_desc: Your 7-day khatmah will run for 7 consecutive days starting from your chosen date.
onboarding.step3_desc: We will send one gentle daily reminder with today's assigned reading portion.
onboarding.reminder_note: No spam. If you complete your portion early, that day's reminder is cancelled automatically.
onboarding.step4_desc: Please review your challenge plan before beginning.
onboarding.permission_note: Next, we will ask permission to send notifications so we can remind you.

home.behind_schedule_desc: You have missed portions. You can continue today's portion or adjust your plan.
home.concluded_desc: Your 7-day period has concluded. You can start a fresh 7-day journey whenever you are ready.
home.upcoming_desc: Day 1 begins on {}. Here is your first portion so you can prepare.
home.backup_prompt: Keep this khatmah safe by saving a backup file.

progress.title: Your Journey
progress.concluded_banner_desc: The 7-day timeframe has elapsed. Completed: {} of 7 portions.
progress.no_cycles_sub: Start a new 7-day challenge to record your reading consistency.
progress.tips_body: Try to keep your daily time consistent. Even a small step makes a big difference!

day_detail.late_check_in_hint: Forgot to tap on the day? You can still record it.
day_detail.page_note: Page numbers follow the standard 604-page Madani mushaf.

adjust_plan.title: Adjust Remaining Plan
adjust_plan.description: We redistributed your unread portions consecutively across the remaining days of your khatmah. Completed portions are preserved.
adjust_plan.concluded_desc:
Your 7-day challenge period has ended. The plan cannot be adjusted because there are no active days remaining.

You can start a new 7-day khatmah from the home or progress screen anytime.

completion_dialog.title: Alhamdulillah
completion_dialog.subtitle: You completed your 7-day khatmah.
completion_dialog.dua: May Allah accept your recitation and make it a light in your heart.

settings.title: Settings
settings.daily_reminder_desc: Receive gentle daily notice for your assigned portion
settings.restart_dialog_desc: You will begin again from Day 1 today. Your current attempt is kept in your Journey history.
settings.new_dialog_desc: Your current challenge is still in progress. Starting a new one will archive your current progress.
settings.app_desc: A companion for completing the Qur'an in seven days. This app helps you stay committed to your daily recitation.
settings.hadith_text: Narrated ʿAbdullah bin ʿAmr: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Read the Qur'an in a month." I said: "I find strength [to read more]," until he said: "Then read it in seven days, and do not exceed that."
settings.health_blocked_desc: Reminders cannot appear until you allow notifications.
settings.health_inexact_desc: Allow "Alarms & reminders" so reminders fire on time.
settings.follow_up_desc: A second gentle nudge if today's portion is still unread
settings.follow_up_must_be_later: Choose a time after your daily reminder.
settings.auto_continue_desc: Begin the next 7-day khatmah automatically after finishing one
settings.auto_continue_started: A new 7-day khatmah has begun. May Allah bless it.
settings.import_backup_desc: From a backup file or text you saved earlier
settings.import_failed: That does not look like a valid backup.
settings.import_warning: Restoring replaces your current progress on this device.
settings.save_backup_file_desc: Save or send your progress as a file (Drive, Telegram, email…)
settings.backup_auto_note: When your phone's backup is turned on, your progress is also saved to it automatically.

confirmation.mark_completed_desc: Have you finished reading today's portion (Day {})?
confirmation.undo_desc: Would you like to mark today's portion as incomplete?
confirmation.continue_today_desc: You have missed portions from earlier days. Do you want to proceed with today's portion without adjusting your schedule?
confirmation.adjust_plan_desc: Would you like to review and redistribute your remaining uncompleted portions across your remaining days?
confirmation.apply_plan_desc: This will redistribute your remaining portions across your remaining days. This updates your daily schedule.

reading.plan_hint: Tick each part as you finish it. We will remember where you stopped.
reading.picker_desc: Default for days you have not finished. Days you set individually keep their own plan.
reading.option_prayers_desc: Five parts, one after each daily prayer
reading.option_three_desc: Three equal parts through the day
reading.option_two_desc: Two halves, for example morning and evening
reading.option_off_desc: No plan. Just mark the day complete when you finish.
reading.day_picker_desc: Changes this day only. The default for all days is in Settings.

permissions.explainer_desc: To remind you exactly at your chosen time, Android needs the "Alarms & reminders" permission. It is only used for your daily Qur'an reminder.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Your last change may not have been saved.

share.completion_message: Alhamdulillah! I completed a full khatmah of the Qur'an in 7 days ({} – {}) with 30 Juz' in 7 Days.
share.subject: Khatmah completed
